statements.status_notes: BC-FJA BC-FIPS versions 2.1.0 through 2.1.2 are affected on Linux x86_64 systems using AVX or AVX-512f. The issue affects the native GCM implementation in gcm128w and gcm512w. BC-FIPS 2.1.3 is the fixed release and is available from Maven Central; Data Prepper currently ships 2.1.2, and adoption of the fixed release is pending.

CVE-2026-8149 is a local availability issue in Bouncy Castle BC-FIPS 2.1.0-2.1.2 affecting specific CPU instruction sets (AVX, AVX-512f) on Linux x86_64. bc-fips 2.1.2 is bundled in the eclipse-temurin FIPS JRE as a transitive dependency required for FIPS 140-3 compliance (CMVP #4943). No upstream fix is available; the FIPS module certification requires bc-fips 2.1.0, and the JRE vendor has not released a patched version. The vulnerability requires local access and affects only the GCM cipher mode implementation. Stargate FIPS variants inherit this dependency from the certified JRE and cannot independently upgrade bc-fips without breaking FIPS compliance. Tracking upstream eclipse-temurin for a certified update that resolves CVE-2026-8149 while maintaining CMVP #4943 certification.

Nessie FIPS variants bundle Bouncy Castle bc-fips 2.1.2 (BCFIPS_VERSION via image/.bouncycastle.inc.yaml). No upstream fix is available: the GHSA advisory (GHSA-mx76-r943-rf8g) records first_patched_version as null and Maven Central currently publishes no release beyond 2.1.2. The flaw is in the AVX-widened GCM pipelines (gcm128w/gcm512w) on x86_64 hosts and impacts availability only (CVSS AV:L). Remediation requires upstream Bouncy Castle to ship a patched 2.x release. Nessie non-FIPS variants do not include bc-fips and are not affected.
